description: Build, fix and follow the person's own art styles: Claude Code runs inside Dinoctor and does the work. Only one style job runs at a time. action build: start a brand-new style from words and/or example pictures (name, words, files), the same as "Build your own style". Claude Code runs inside Dinoctor on this computer and builds the style in code: it plans the look, draws characters, objects and places, writes the style, runs the app's tests, checks a test shot and makes the pictures. Usually about 30 minutes (longer for a detailed 3D style), and it uses a lot of the person's own Claude usage (a smaller plan can hit its limit). Nothing is paid to Dinoctor. The person can keep working, and style_job with action cancel stops it at any time. Claude first writes a plan; when status shows status plan, show it to the person and answer it with action continue. action fix: ask Claude to fix a problem (words) in one of the person's own finished styles (id), like Fix a problem (about 10 minutes of their Claude usage); the style stays as it was until the fix passes. action continue: answer a new style's plan (build it, or send change to rework it), or resume a build or fix that stopped part way (status says canContinue: true). build, fix and continue use the person's Claude usage, so the first call only says what will happen; ask, then call again with the same arguments and confirm: true. action status (read-only unless close: true, which clears a finished job from Dinoctor's screen): status (running, plan, done, failed, cancelled), step, what Claude does now, minutes so far and left, tokens, errors. action cancel: stops the running job; the person's styles stay as they were. When done, use_style switches to it and rate_style records how it went.

action.description: build a new style, fix one, continue a plan or a stopped job, cancel the running job, or get its status.

change.description: continue, when status shows a plan: what the person wants changed. With it, Claude rewrites the plan instead of building.

close.description: status: clear a finished, failed or cancelled job from Dinoctor's screen.

confirm.description: build, fix, continue: true starts it (uses the person's Claude usage). Only after the person said yes.

files.description: build: full paths of pictures or short videos on this computer that show the look (up to 25 MB each). They show Claude far more than words.

id.description: fix: The person's own style id from my_styles (built-in styles can't be used here).

name.description: build: the style's name, up to 30 characters.

use_project_files.description: build: also send the files already added in Dinoctor's Build your own box.

words.description: build: the look (characters, world, mood, lettering), needed unless files are sent. fix: what's wrong, in plain words.

name: style_job
